The '''Judicial Arcology''' was a building on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that served as the headquarters of the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]].<ref name="Hnn 48" /> [[Warren Sloat]] was one of its ranking officers, and it contained [[Judicial Hearing Chamber Y-76]].<ref name="Hnn 49" />
